items.title: Ruthie Foster interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 28, 2023
items.q: How about Joe Williams, not Big Joe Williams

ctx.x: Powerful. Nothing but power. Absolutely. I grew up listening to a lot of Mahalia, and still do. Still do. To remind myself when you sing remember where that comes from and not just spirit-wise but even physically. You’re listening to her sing and she’s a very physical singer. As a vocalist or just as a musician who’s knowledgeable about that and the physics of when it comes to how you use your body, you see and you feel that with Mahalia. You know where it’s coming from.
How about Joe Williams, not Big Joe Williams, Joe Williams of the Basie —
Yeah. Yeah. What I love about Joe Williams is his phrasing and really relaxed way of singing, his style. Yeah. Very, very stylish and he picked some really great tunes as well.
